content.text: The failure confirms get() has no insertion timestamp to compare. Adding self._inserted stamped in set(), and evicting in get() when now - inserted > ttl_seconds.
Fixed: entries now carry an insertion timestamp and expire on get(); all three tests pass and the set/get API is unchanged.

result: Added TTL expiry to TTLCache: insertion timestamps in set(), eviction on get() past ttl_seconds. Tests pass.
